summary: S&P Global Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of a $2 billion private offering of senior notes by Mobility Global Inc., a newly formed holding company for its Mobility division, ahead of a planned spin-off to shareholders. The offering includes $650M 5.050% notes due 2029, $650M 5.450% notes due 2031, and $700M 6.050% notes due 2036, priced May 19, 2026 with expected close May 29, 2026. The notes are sold to QIBs under Rule 144A and offshore under Regulation S. The filing signals debt capitalization before the tax-free spin-off. Watch for the distribution date, listing details, and post-spin capital structure.
